### The Forgiveness of Sins
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-forgiveness-of-sins
Passage: Micah 7:18-19
Points:
- Micah marvels at God's unique character as the Lord who delights in steadfast love and pardons iniquity.
- Unlike false gods, the true God forgives sinners without compromising His perfect justice.
- Divine forgiveness is secured through Christ, allowing God to be both just and Justifier.
- Hurling sins into the ocean means God will never again hold them against believers.
- Experiencing God's generous pardon frees believers from guilt and calls them to forgive others readily.
